1.body:
Hello,

I saw Unstitched is building an AI platform that simplifies content creation, and your focus on structured design systems immediately caught my attention.

At AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and turned findings directly into cleaner user flows and interface usability. I also built reusable design systems at Ascent Business Solutions that cut turnaround time for digital and print assets.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates how I design a cleaner verification experience for teams, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Mumbai, and would love to share a quick look at my work. Are you free for a brief chat this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
